maildir_path.description: The path to the local maildir directory to be synchronized.

and_tags.description: List of tags that must appear on both replicas to be retained during sync. If empty, falls back to new.tags logic or default behavior.

synchronize_flags.description: Whether to enable maildir flag synchronization. Recommended to be false for muchsync efficiency.

new_tags.description: List of tags automatically applied to new messages. Used as default for muchsync.and_tags if not explicitly set in muchsync section.
